item.title: Spotlight On: This weekend's big talking points from ASCO 2026
item.description: On the ground at this year’s ASCO meeting, executive editor of pharmaceutical news analysis Michael Flanagan highlights some of the key topics of conversation.

item.title: Spotlight On: Obesity's next battleground built on lessons from market disruptors
item.description: While nontraditional players in the obesity market have been a thorn in the side of big pharma, a silver lining emerging from the scuffles is the insight these companies have provided into patient preferences shaping the next wave of care.

item.title: Vital Signs: Pfizer re-shuffles its ADC deck as Seagen assets sink
item.description: Ahead of its new antibody-drug conjugate (ADC)-focused deal with Innovent, Pfizer has been putting additional Seagen-derived ADCs on the chopping block. After spending $43 billion, is it in with Innovent, and out with Seagen for its ADC aspirations?

item.title: ASCO ViewPoints: How Revolution plans to maintain its pan-RAS lead
item.description: FirstWord sat down with Revolution Medicines' Chief Development Officer Alan Sandler to discuss what's next for the biotech's RAS pipeline.

item.title: ASCO Spotlight: Bispecific fast-followers accelerate into ivonescimab's slipstream
item.description: Akeso and Summit Therapeutics' drug remains the front-runner in the closely-watched class of novel cancer therapies, but ASCO discussant says it remains too early to be declared an outright winner.

item.title: Spotlight On: GSK delivers historic win for hepatitis B patients
item.description: GSK has described newly disclosed Phase III data for its investigational hepatitis B treatment bepirovirsen as "unprecedented."
